title: Powertrain Virtual Calibration & Validation
summary: An engineering decision-support tool in development to connect physics-based simulation with measured test evidence, helping teams explore calibration choices and decide what to validate next.
audience: For powertrain calibration, simulation, and validation teams.

steps.title: Connect the evidence
steps.detail: Bring simulation outputs and existing test measurements into a common workflow.

steps.title: Understand the uncertainty
steps.detail: Explore where model predictions and measured behaviour differ, and where evidence is still missing.

steps.title: Choose the next test
steps.detail: Prioritise measurements that could reduce uncertainty and support the next engineering decision.

note: Currently at the concept and prototype stage. The intended workflow supports engineering judgement; physical testing and validation remain essential.
